camel_example: aliyun iot QueryVehicleDevice --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot-2w0000' --ProductKey a1Bw0000 --DeviceName light
description_en: Queries the information about a cloud gateway device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询云网关设备信息
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-vehicle-device --iot-instance-id iot-2w0000 --product-key a1Bw0000 --device-name light --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryVehicleDevice

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the cloud gateway product to which the device belongs
parameters.help_zh: 设备所属云网关产品的ProductKey
parameters.name: product_key

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see Error codes below
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见下文错误码

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the device was created. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 设备创建时间的时间戳。单位为毫秒

IotId.description_en: The ID issued by IoT Platform for the device. This is the unique identifier of the device
IotId.description_zh: 物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符

JtProtocolDeviceData.description_en: The registration and authentication information returned only for JT/T 808 protocol cloud gateway devices
JtProtocolDeviceData.description_zh: 仅JT/T 808协议云网关设备返回的注册认证信息

AuthCode.description_en: The authentication code of the device

City.description_en: The city where the device is registered

Province.description_en: The province where the device is registered

RegisterTime.description_en: The timestamp when the device was registered. Unit: milliseconds
RegisterTime.description_zh: 设备注册时间的时间戳。单位为毫秒

Status.description_en:
The device status. Valid values:

create: The device is created.
register: The device is registered.
unregister: The device is unregistered
Status.description_zh:
设备状态。可取值：

create：设备已创建。
register：设备已注册。
unregister：设备已注销

VehicleColour.description_en: The vehicle plate color. The value must comply with the JT/T 808 protocol requirements. For more information, see JT/T 808-2019 protocol (https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221220/mdsf/JT-T%20808-2019.pdf)
VehicleColour.description_zh: 车牌颜色。取值符合标准JT/T 808协议要求即可。详细说明，请参见JT/T 808的2019版本协议 (https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221220/mdsf/JT-T%20808-2019.pdf)

ModifiedTime.description_en: The timestamp when the device was last updated. Unit: milliseconds
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 设备更新时间的时间戳。单位为毫秒

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the cloud gateway product to which the device belongs
ProductKey.description_zh: 设备所属云网关产品的ProductKey

Protocol.description_en:
The cloud gateway protocol type. Valid values:

gb32960: GB/T 32960 protocol.
jt808: JT/T 808 protocol.
sl651: SL 651 protocol
Protocol.description_zh:
云网关协议类型。取值：

gb32960：GB/T 32960协议。
jt808：JT/T 808协议。
sl651：SL 651协议

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
